about.subtitle: Building a community where every pet can find their perfect playmate.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: At Patty, we believe every pet deserves companionship, play, and friendship. Our mission is to connect pet owners in their local communities, making it easy to arrange playdates and build lasting friendships for both pets and their humans.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Patty was born from a simple observation: our pets are happier when they have friends to play with. As pet owners ourselves, we struggled to find compatible playmates for our furry companions. Dog parks were unpredictable, and social media groups were disorganized.
story.paragraph2: We envisioned an app that would make finding pet playdates as easy as swiping right. A platform built on trust, safety, and genuine connection. That's how Patty came to be.
story.paragraph3: Today, Patty is growing into a vibrant community of pet lovers who share our belief that every pet deserves a best friend.

safe-pet-playdates.title: 5 Tips for a Safe First Pet Playdate
safe-pet-playdates.excerpt: Meeting another pet owner for the first time? Here's how to ensure a safe and fun experience for everyone.

content.intro: Meeting another pet owner through Patty is exciting! Here are our top tips to ensure a safe and enjoyable first playdate.
content.tip1Content: Meet at a public park or designated dog park rather than at someone's home. This helps both pets feel more comfortable and reduces territorial behavior.
content.tip2Content: A 20-30 minute playdate is perfect for the first meeting. This gives you time to see how the pets interact without overwhelming them.
content.tip3Content: Playing is thirsty work! Having water available keeps both pets hydrated and happy.
content.tip4Content: Learn to read your pet's signals. Loose, wiggly bodies mean they're having fun. Stiff postures or tucked tails may indicate stress.
content.tip5Content: After a successful playdate, stay in touch! You might have found a perfect match for regular meetups.
content.outro: Have fun and stay safe out there!

matching-algorithm.title: How Patty's Matching Algorithm Works
matching-algorithm.excerpt: Discover the technology behind finding the perfect playmate for your furry friend.

content.intro: At Patty, we believe finding the right playmate for your pet should be both fun and effective. Here's a peek behind the curtain at how our matching system works.
content.section1Content: We use your approximate location to show you pets within your preferred distance. This ensures playdates are convenient for both parties.
content.section2Content: Our algorithm considers pet species (dogs with dogs, cats with cats) and can filter by breed preferences you set.
content.section3Content: Like any good matchmaking, both parties need to be interested. Our swipe system ensures mutual consent before connecting owners.
content.section4Content: We factor in energy levels and play styles to suggest compatible playmates.
content.section5Content: The more you use Patty, the better our recommendations become as we learn your preferences.

introducing-patty.title: Introducing Patty: A New Way to Connect Pet Lovers
introducing-patty.excerpt: We're excited to launch Patty, the app that brings pet owners together for playdates and friendship.

content.intro: We're thrilled to announce the launch of Patty, the app designed to connect pet owners for playdates, friendship, and community.
content.section1Content: As pet owners ourselves, we know how challenging it can be to find playmates for our furry friends. Local dog parks can be hit or miss, and arranging meetups through social media is cumbersome.
content.section2Content: Patty brings the familiar swipe-to-match interface to pet socialization. Create a profile for you and your pet, discover nearby pet owners, and connect with those who share your love for animals.
content.section3Content: Built-in verification system, real-time chat, location-based discovery, and a focus on safety and community guidelines.
content.section4Content: Download Patty today and start finding playmates for your pets. Every pet deserves a best friend!

pet-socialization-benefits.title: Why Socialization Matters for Your Pet
pet-socialization-benefits.excerpt: Regular interaction with other animals can improve your pet's behavior, health, and happiness.

content.intro: Just like humans, pets benefit greatly from regular social interaction. Here's why socialization should be a priority for every pet owner.
content.section1Content: Well-socialized pets are typically calmer, less anxious, and better behaved in various situations. They learn to read social cues and respond appropriately.
content.section2Content: Active play with other pets provides excellent exercise, helping maintain a healthy weight and improving cardiovascular health.
content.section3Content: Interacting with new animals and environments keeps your pet's mind sharp and prevents boredom-related behavioral issues.
content.section4Content: Regular positive interactions help shy or anxious pets build confidence and become more comfortable in new situations.
content.section5Content: Use Patty to find compatible playmates and schedule regular playdates. Your pet will thank you!
